title: 2025 Kia Niro Collision Repair
summary: Collision repair and quarter panel replacement on a 2025 Kia Niro at Carcis Autobody Repair in Vancouver, WA.
story: This 2025 Kia Niro arrived with heavy passenger side collision damage. The rear door panel metal was deeply gouged and torn open. The rear quarter panel area around the wheel well and pillar sustained structural crushing, requiring complete panel disassembly and outer structure replacement.

Technicians cut away the compromised sheet metal and prepped the inner structure. A replacement quarter panel was fitted, measured for alignment, and welded in place according to factory specifications. The right rear door shell was repaired, prepped, and seamlessly integrated with adjacent body lines.

After body fill, priming, and block sanding, the panels were painted to match the factory green coat. The shop reinstalled the tail lamp assembly, handle components, and lower cladding. Final polishing returned the exterior to factory condition.
